description: The donut chart illustrates the composition of the Darija Open Dataset, Version 2, categorizing its contents into six distinct types. The largest segment, represented by a green color, corresponds to "Pending Translations" and accounts for 43,000 entries. The second largest segment, in a golden-yellow hue, represents "Translated Sentences" with 45,387 entries. The "Extra + Augmented Data" category, shown in a dark blue-gray, makes up 30,000 entries. "Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)" is depicted in a brownish-tan color and comprises 23,108 entries. The "Moroccan Names" category, in a reddish-brown shade, and the "Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)" category, in a dark purple, are the smallest segments, each representing a very small portion of the dataset, with the latter being particularly minimal. The chart includes a legend on the right side that matches each category to its corresponding color, and the numerical values for each category are displayed within the respective slices of the donut.
